id: get-node-sysctl
title: "List the kernel's parameters and which osapi manages"
description: "Lists every parameter the kernel shows under /proc/sys, with its current value, as sysctl -a does, and marks the ones osapi manages. A prefix, such as net.ipv4, narrows it to that part of the tree. A parameter osapi manages that the kernel does not have right now, such as one whose module is not loaded, is listed with the value osapi wrote."

Lists every parameter the kernel shows under /proc/sys, with its current value, as sysctl -a does, and marks the ones osapi manages. A prefix, such as net.ipv4, narrows it to that part of the tree. A parameter osapi manages that the kernel does not have right now, such as one whose module is not loaded, is listed with the value osapi wrote.
